findings.title: Normalize malformed UTF8 model HTTP responses without losing HTTP status
findings.summary: P2: public LlamaCppInteraction.send with correctly framed body byte ff leaks UnicodeDecodeError both for HTTP200 and500. Expected typed LlamaCppResponseError for successful-status malformed body and LlamaCppHttpError retaining500 for error response. Current _post_json/_error_detail decode outside appropriate normalization. One invocation, finally closes connection, no observation or retry. Preserve primary HTTP status, causal decoding detail and existing valid/chunked/error controls; add real maintained-caller deterministic wire regressions.
findings.acceptance: 200 invalid UTF8 yields ResponseError;500 invalid UTF8 yields HttpError withstatus500; valid UTF8/JSON unchanged; exactly one request and closed writer; no retry or fabricated observation.

findings.title: Handle short HTTP reads and nonobject model-list JSON in vLLM readiness
findings.summary: P2: VLLMServer.status against a healthy owned-container fake returns readyFalse when valid matching /v1/models JSON arrives after a legal short read. A complete valid JSON [] or null instead raises AttributeError through .get rather than established conservative runningTrue/readyFalse. _http_get consumes only one read(65536); _probe_model_ready assumes dict root. Repair narrow existing readiness mechanics; preserve alias match/mismatch, malformed response, cancellation and timeout controls without a new HTTP framework.
findings.acceptance: Valid matching alias with split header/body is ready; nonobject listing refuses readiness without AttributeError; wrong/missing alias remains false; all owned response streams close; source of liveness versus readiness distinct.

findings.title: Close owned serving readiness streams on read failure cancellation and timeout
findings.summary: P2: both public serving status/wait paths leave their opened StreamWriter unclosed when read raises OSError, cancellation or timeout. Six deterministic stream cases plus a real ephemeral local HTTP sink cancellation demonstrate missing finally settlement. Under retained fixture reference actual writer is_closingFalse after task cancellation settles. This proves failure to release the owned connection at operation boundary, not leaked inference process or permanent OS leak. Repair existing helpers; preserve original failure/cancellation, await close appropriately and do not retry model/process work.
findings.acceptance: Both serving adapters settle owned stream close after error/cancel/readiness timeout and success; original outcomes preserved; real loopback cancellation control; no stale waiter/automatic external retry. Separate from delivered Command collector37a647f2.

findings.title: Distinguish Docker registry port from explicit image tag in serving admission
findings.summary: P2: both serving configurations accept registry.example:5000/team/server although existing policy requires explicit tag or digest. A colon in registry port is not a tag in final image component. Repair local existing config admission; preserve server:cuda and server@sha256:<64hex> controls, unqualified/blank and other current validation. Probe only constructs configs, never Docker. An explicit mutable tag is not cryptographic model/image immutability.
findings.acceptance: Registry-port-only image refused before executor; same registry with explicit last-component tag or digest accepted; valid existing images unchanged; independent both-adapter configuration tests.

findings.title: Reject nonstandard JSON constants in model Tool schemas and requested arguments
findings.summary: P2: ModelToolDefinition and ToolDescriptor accept schema {"type":"object","default":NaN}; actual llama request contains NaN and independent strict JSON parser rejects wire. Native response Tool arguments containing NaN,Infinity,-Infinity are admitted as ModelToolCall despite valid-JSON object contract. Standard json.loads/dumps defaults are permissive. Fix compatible existing boundaries and direct Qwen disclosure composition without a new JSON or schema framework. Preserve raw valid call spelling and object checks; do not confuse valid large number grammar such as1e999 with nonstandard constant tokens or expand duplicate-member/metaschema policy.
findings.acceptance: NaN/Infinity/-Infinity refused at definition/disclosure and native-call normalization boundaries, no invalid outgoing request; valid literal/null/number/nested object controls and raw call spelling retained. No Tool execution or authority claim; no rewrite of generic rich JsonFile semantics.
